newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal seen cutting draining rate 10-50 bp.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal seen cutting draining rate 10-50 bp.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal could cut its draining rate by 10 to 50 basis points at the start of a new commercial bank reserve period on Monday, dealers said.
Earlier today the central bank trimmed its repo (injection) rate by 10 bp to 7.00 percent, taking local financial markets by surprise and causing Portuguese Treasury bonds to rise, they said.

"If the Bank of Portugal maintains its policy of substantial cuts in the draining rate in order to make room for gradual cuts in the repo rate, the draining rate could drop to 6.50 percent," said one dealer.
The rate used to drain funds from the money market is presently 6.80 percent.
All seven operators contacted by Reuters agreed that the Bank of Portugal would probably cut its draining rate on Monday.
Most believed the rate would drop by 25 to 30 bp, although one said the cut could be as little as 10 bp and two said it could be as much as 50 bp.
